overall_intent: A reference-guided traveler negotiating a railway permit in an intimate gaslit period drawing room, with a visible practical spell connecting the document and recipient.

contact_point.reason: The meaningful magic and paper exchange need readable endpoints and clear owners.
contact_point.expressive_goal: Make an offered permit and a receiving ring hand relate across a small readable gap.
owner_relations: The woman supports the near document edge.
The patron owns the signet ring and raised hand.
The magic joins the wax seal to the receiving ring.
required_constraints: Retain visible magic and the reference-guided woman.
preserved_choices: A two-person exchange can stay quiet and consequential.
open_scope: Unbound hand staging, object relation, material behavior and spacing.
contact_point.role_focus: A document offered between two seated people, supported by one hand while a continuous visible magical connection bridges the document seal and the other person's raised ring hand.
contact_point.scene_context: An intimate period drawing room at dusk; the relation should read as a pause during a permit negotiation.

grounds.quote: A travel permit is presented while a visible spell connects its seal to its prospective recipient

review.author: Codex
review.rationale: The intended relation is an authored exchange, with complete endpoints and ownership more useful than decorative symbolism.

historical_period.reason: Period social context should distinguish Gaslamp Fantasy from a modern room containing a glow.
historical_period.expressive_goal: A believable late-nineteenth-century domestic reception in which practical enchantment is familiar.
owner_relations: The woman and patron share a small table in a private reception room.
required_constraints: Retain Gaslamp Fantasy and the main reference-guided woman.
open_scope: Specific period furnishings, clothing context and time treatment.
historical_period.role_focus: Late-nineteenth-century private drawing-room reception for an exchange of a travel document, ordinary etiquette and gaslight coexisting with visibly working enchantment.
historical_period.scene_context: One traveler and one railway patron at a small table, faces and hand-to-document relations close enough to read.

grounds.quote: Private drawing room with functioning gas sconces at dusk
